question: Why do pirates wear eyepatches?

options.text: To maintain night vision in both eyes
To cover up an embarrassing birthmark
Because they lost an eye in battle

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains **that pirates wear eyepatches to switch the patch from eye to eye and maintain night vision in both eyes.**
 
• This detail highlights a practical reason for the eyepatch beyond the common assumption of injury.
 
• "**To maintain night vision in both eyes**" accurately captures the reason mentioned in the passage.

Therefore, the correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is **'****To maintain night vision in both eyes.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Other options ("to cover up an embarrassing birthmark", "because they lost an eye in battle", "to intimidate their enemies") are either not mentioned or not the primary reason discussed in the passage.

 
• **To cover up an embarrassing birthmark** (एक शर्मनाक जन्मचिह्न को छिपाने के लिए): This reason is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Because they lost an eye in battle** (क्योंकि उन्होंने युद्ध में एक आंख खो दी): The passage dismisses this common assumption.
 
• **To intimidate their enemies** (अपने दुश्मनों को डराने के लिए): This is not the reason discussed in the passage.
